Frequently Asked Questions

What makes MATE activewear different?

MATE activewear is designed for movement, made with thoughtfully sourced materials, and held to higher standards. Our signature Organic Stretch fabric is made with GOTS-certified organic cotton and is free from BPA, PFAS, formaldehyde, and toxic dyes. It’s also OEKO-TEX® Standard 100 certified, meaning finished materials are tested for harmful substances.


From the fiber to the finished garment, GOTS certification sets standards for responsible processing, wastewater practices, and social conditions throughout the supply chain. The result is activewear designed to move with you, feel good against skin, and meet a higher standard of what clothing can be.

Why did MATE choose organic cotton for activewear?

Made with organic cotton, our Organic Stretch fabric is breathable and designed to keep you comfortable through movement. The fabric allows air to circulate while its soft, flexible stretch moves with you. Unlike synthetic moisture-wicking fabrics, organic cotton absorbs moisture rather than pulling it away from the skin.

Are MATE leggings squat-proof?

Our leggings offer comfortable coverage for everyday movement, though opacity can vary depending on color, size, and how the fabric is stretched. For maximum coverage, we recommend choosing your true size and opting for darker shades.
